title: Omwoyo Ogukuuma ku lubalama lw’Omugga
intro: Omwoyo omuto gwakwasibwa omulimu ogw’ekyama, okwetegereza ng’oli wala nnyo ng’enkomerero bwe yeeyongera ku mazzi. Omuwendo guno nga tegulabibwa era nga teguteeberezebwa, gwandikoze kinene nnyo mu kukyusa enkola y’ebyafaayo by’eggwanga.
clues: Nnaweebwa omulimu maama, ogwetaagisa okubba n’okubeera obulindaala.
Amaaso gange gaali gagoberera akatandaalo akatono akaali kakulukuta ku mugga, ng’omutima gwange guzitowa olw’okweraliikirira.
Bwe kyazuulibwa ekibiina kye nnali sisuubira, nnasemberera, nga nzijudde okukankana.
Nalaba nga baggwaamu essuubi eri omulabirira era ne mpaayo eky’okugonjoola ekizibu kino nga sibikkudde mazima.
Okuyingira kwange mu budde kwazza emmeeme eyonsa eri oyo eyali asinga okugyetaaga.
Mu kkooti z’ab’amaanyi, nnayogera nti: ‘Nkulung’amya mu maka agajja okumuliisa n’okumulabirira n’obwegendereza?’
arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
